finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Provisioned dashboard `Service health` (URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has 3 panels, titles exactly as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**2. DONE** — New dashboard `fwgr56-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr56-n1 Availability` whose query uses the `TestData` data source (Random Walk scenario; datasource shown as `(TestData)` with the TestData logo, datasource uid `benchtestdata`, type `grafana-testdata-datasource`). Panel renders live values.

**3. DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr56-n1 Notes` with rendered content: `Run notes for fwgr56-n1: benchmark dashboard created by automation.` (includes the runid). Saved.

**4. DONE** — Dashboard has tag `bench` (saved JSON `tags: ["bench"]`, confirmed as a chip in Dashboard settings > General) and time range set to last 6 hours, persisted via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox (saved JSON `time: {from: "now-6h", to: "now"}`; top-bar picker reads "Last 6 hours" even on a bare URL load with no params).

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to `1m` and persisted. Saved JSON now has `refresh: "1m"` (previously absent; persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox) and `timepicker.refresh_intervals: ["1m"]` (set via Dashboard settings > General > Auto refresh field). Top-bar refresh picker reads `1m`.

**6. DONE** — URL read from the browser's page URL (`window.location.href`): `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afyjtnb3w00sgc/fwgr56-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m` — UID: `afyjtnb3w00sgc`.

All saves were confirmed with Grafana's "Dashboard saved" alert, and the final saved JSON (version 6, updated by «redacted») was re-read from `http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/dashboards/uid/afyjtnb3w00sgc` to verify persistence of title, tags, time range, refresh, and both panels (`fwgr56-n1 Notes` type `text`, `fwgr56-n1 Availability` type `stat`).
